Eric / Megan — thanks for the quick review. Answers inline below and an updated compact schedule at the bottom. I also attached the runbook excerpt and the canary test script for your ops team to review.

1) Migration window (11/10–11/11):
- Expected RTO: 30 minutes for critical inference endpoint (we'll keep a blue-green fallback ready).
- Expected RPO: near-zero for inference state (model artifacts will be synced; user-requested persistence is outside inference path).
- On-call: propose primary ops contact from Helion (Megan) + Redwood on-call (Laura). We will run a pre-cutover smoke test one business day before.

2) Canary rollback triggers:
- Latency spike: >200ms p50 increase sustained for 15m.
- Error rate: >1% 5xx for 10m.
- Quality regression: automated eval on the holdout prompt set shows >5% drop in top-line accuracy or a reproducible hallucination pattern flagged by the eval harness.
- Any of the above triggers immediate traffic shift to previous model variant + incident bridge.

- Train-the-trainer (11/3) will include 90-minute walkthrough + 60-minute hands-on lab in the exact canary sandbox; credentials and ephemeral datasets will be provided.
